hero.lead: A nation of 143.5 million with forest across half its land and oil and gas rents of 15.6% of GDP, whose National Wealth Fund held 12.985 trillion roubles on 1 October 2026.

capital.heading: A wealth fund, and safe water for every home.

record.text: National Wealth Fund on 1 October 2026, 5.5% of projected GDP; liquid assets of RUB 3.8 trillion
record.source: Ministry of Finance of Russia, read in TASS, 2026

record.text: Far Eastern and Arctic Mortgage loans at a preferential rate of 2% a year to more than 51,000 teachers and medical workers, reported 12 November 2026
General government gross debt, share of GDP, 2025

register.name: Far Eastern and Arctic Mortgage, loans to teachers and doctors
register.detail: Ministry of Finance of the Russian Federation · reported 12 November 2026 · preferential rate of 2% a year · 44,818 loans for RUB 246.2bn in the Far East · 6,207 loans for RUB 25.5bn in the Arctic zone
register.note: 26,247 loans to teachers and 24,778 to doctors; the release does not state the period the figures cover
register.text: A state-supported mortgage that lets buyers acquire a home in the Far East and the Arctic at a preferential rate of 2% a year; more than 51,000 teachers and medical workers have used it. It serves the shelter standard, the standard furthest from reach in Russia.

register.name: National Wealth Fund
register.detail: Ministry of Finance of the Russian Federation · 1 October 2026
register.text: A fiscal fund built from oil and gas revenue; its liquid part is held in yuan and gold at the Bank of Russia.

register.name: Federal project “Modernisation of Communal Infrastructure”
register.detail: National project “Infrastructure for Life” · reported 17 September 2026 · more than 1,700 communal facilities built, modernised or overhauled since 2025 · memoranda signed with 83 participating regions
register.note: No amount is given on the page; comprehensive plans include more than 50,000 measures to renew more than 18,000 communal facilities and about 140,000 km of networks
register.text: The federal project that renews water mains, water supply and other communal infrastructure in the regions; it improved the quality of communal services for more than 8.6 million Russians from 2025, toward a national goal of 20 million by 2030. It serves the water standard, where 76.3% of people have safely managed drinking water.

register.name: Subsidies for wastewater treatment plants, federal project “Water of Russia”
register.detail: Government of the Russian Federation · announced 16 June 2025 · subsidies to the regions over five years · nearly RUB 24bn in the first three years · open to all regions by competitive selection
register.note: Support named for the central sewerage system of Kineshma, Ivanovo Region, and the reconstruction of the Nizhny Novgorod aeration station
register.text: Federal subsidies to build and rebuild wastewater treatment plants and renew communal facilities in key settlements, under the federal project “Water of Russia” of the national project “Ecological Well-being”. It serves the shelter standard, measured by safely managed sanitation, which 41.8% of people in Russia lack.

assets.heading: Five assets no balance sheet counts.

items.name: The Oil and Gas
items.label: Of GDP from oil and gas rents, 2021
items.text: Oil and gas already earn; the task is to turn the rent into assets that outlast it.

items.name: The Forest
items.label: Of the land under forest, 2024
items.text: Standing forest that stores carbon and water, and can earn as it stands.

items.name: The Fresh Water
items.label: Renewable fresh water a person, 2022
items.text: Rain and rivers renewed every year: power, irrigation and drinking water.

items.name: The Land
items.label: Land area, 2023
items.text: Territory to farm, power and protect.

items.name: The Minerals
items.label: Of GDP from mineral rents, 2021
items.text: Metals and minerals already earn; the task is to keep more of their value at home.

items.name: Prosthetic and Orthopaedic Rehabilitation Centre
items.text: A company in the Orenburg Region, led by Alexander Gaidukov, that makes modern limb prostheses and corsets and takes patients through full rehabilitation, from psychological preparation to training in using them; one of three Best Social Entrepreneurs of Russia at the Impulse of Good award of the Our Future foundation in 2025.

items.name: Steplife and Salyut Orto
items.text: A company and group of companies, founded and led by Ivan Khudyakov, that make high-tech limb prostheses for adults and children; Discovery of the Year at the Impulse of Good award in 2024.

items.name: REFORMA
items.text: A Russian maker of high-tech rehabilitation equipment, among it the patented Reforma-TEKT training suit used in neurology, sports medicine and social services, including in the rehabilitation of children with cerebral palsy; Discovery of the Year at the Impulse of Good award in 2025.

items.name: Clever Kids
items.text: A social enterprise in the Kemerovo Region that has given specialised help to children and teenagers with disabilities for more than 11 years, through a learning and correction centre and a free dental clinic; one of three Best Social Entrepreneurs of Russia in 2025.

items.name: Sova-Nyanka
items.text: A company that since 2014 has made professional equipment for sensory integration and developmental sessions with children, used for the rehabilitation and adaptation of children, including children with disabilities, by organisations in Russia, Belarus and Kazakhstan; a Best Social Entrepreneur of Russia in 2024.

items.name: Teplitsa. Berezhno
items.text: An inclusive space in the centre of Rostov-on-Don, opened in April 2025 by the local branch of the “Ya Est!” foundation, with a café, a shop and workshops for people with disabilities, whose staff include neurodivergent people and whose own income lessens its dependence on grants.

items.name: Inclusive Resource Centre
items.text: An organisation founded in 2014 by Alexey Trantsev, the first in the Volga region to develop inclusive projects, that designs employment programmes for people with disabilities and trains companies to build inclusive teams, with a turnover of several tens of millions of roubles a year from its work with business.
